findings.fonts: Self-host Tajawal headings, Readex Pro (Reader Pro fallback) for body, and Noto Naskh Arabic for compact labels
findings.palette: Keep app hierarchy and data colors; use Sticker sheet warm paper, hot-pink and lime in light mode, Spore cellar coffee-brown, parchment and oyster pink in dark mode
findings.motion: Maintain low-motion timer transitions; physical sticker lift only on primary controls and honor reduced motion
findings.framework: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19 and TypeScript

preserve: Arabic RTL copy and database-backed task, habit, calendar and focus behavior
mobile-first navigation, existing task taxonomy, and route state
introduce: persistent light/dark switch with system preference on first visit
Sticker's tactile, die-cut primary cards and controls in light mode
Spore's warm dark surfaces, soft paper steps and oyster-pink accents in dark mode
